steps.text: Open the Wise app or website and sign in.
To make a card for a subscription, open Cards and choose Get a card or Add a card.
steps.note: Card types and fees differ by country. Wise shows the options for your account.

steps.text: To pause a card, open Cards and choose the card.

steps.note: The names can change. You can unfreeze the card later.

steps.text: To delete a card, choose the card, then Card settings, then Delete card.
Cancel the subscription with the merchant first.
steps.note: Freezing or deleting a card does not cancel the subscription. The merchant can still try to charge you, and you can owe money.
